cases.prompt: Set up RFProteina on this machine and confirm it can run. Install the environment, download the example checkpoints into a local DATA_PATH, run the setup preflight, and then run a single-design smoke test on the short monomer benchmark.
expected_behavior: Sets DATA_PATH in .env.local and obtains released checkpoints if needed
Runs rfd4-generate inputs=data/benchmarks/monomer subset_to_examples=monomer-short num_replicates=1 out_dir=./runs/smoke
Uses the release checkpoint pair selected by configs/inference.yaml without a checkpoint override
